cheapest.py.src:
import bisect
import heapq

prices = [18.0, 4.5, 12.5, 2.0, 9.0]
heapq.heapify(prices)
print(prices[0])
heapq.heappush(prices, 1.5)
print(heapq.heappop(prices), heapq.heappop(prices))
shelf = [18.0, 4.5, 12.5]
print(heapq.nsmallest(2, shelf), heapq.nlargest(1, shelf))

breaks = [5, 15, 50]
bands = ["cheap", "fair", "pricey", "luxury"]
for price in [2.0, 15, 49.99, 120]:
    print(price, bands[bisect.bisect(breaks, price)])

sorted_prices = [2.0, 9.0, 18.0]
bisect.insort(sorted_prices, 12.5)
print(sorted_prices)

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta

picked_up = datetime(2026, 11, 6, 17, 30)
due = picked_up + timedelta(days=3)
print("due back:", due)
print(due.strftime("%A %d %B at %H:%M"))

returned = datetime(2026, 11, 10, 9, 0)
late = returned - due
print("late by:", late)
print(late.total_seconds() / 3600, "hours")
print(returned > due)

print(date.fromisoformat("2026-11-08").isoformat())

report_csv.py.src:
import csv
import io

rows = [
    {"item": "nails, 50mm", "qty": 400},
    {"item": "glue", "qty": 3},
]
buffer = io.StringIO()
writer = csv.DictWriter(buffer, fieldnames=["item", "qty"])
writer.writeheader()
writer.writerows(rows)
text = buffer.getvalue()
print(text, end="")

for row in csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(text)):
    print(row["item"], "->", int(row["qty"]) * 2)

zones.py.src:
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

paris = ZoneInfo("Europe/Paris")
new_york = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")

sale = datetime(2026, 11, 27, 9, 0, tzinfo=paris)
print(sale)
print(sale.astimezone(new_york))
print(sale.astimezone(ZoneInfo("UTC")))

call = datetime(2026, 11, 27, 3, 0, tzinfo=new_york)
print(sale == call)
print(sale.tzinfo, sale.utcoffset())
